name: Senkou no Rumina Kouhen ~Midara na Mesu Juu no Maguwari~
original_name: 閃攻のルミナ 後編 ～淫らな雌獣のまぐわり～
source:
The school-infiltrating agent's assault adventure, ends here!

"What if that time, I had gone like this..."

At the crossroads of fate, if detective Lumina Shingu made the right choice
her route continues (concludes) with this followup ADV novel!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE189282.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
潜入学校的搜查员，她的突袭冒险将在此完结！

“如果那时候，我这样做的话……”

在命运的岔路口，假如刑警迅宫ルミナ做出了正确的选择，
她的故事便会在这部后续冒险游戏中继续，并迎来结局！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE189282.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
